title: Accidentally Wide
joke: Tyrol swears the spec said 'slim.' The metal disagreed.
plain: Viper is 25% chunkier: more hurtbox, more intercepted strays.

advice.baltar: I am now a larger target. I did not ask for this responsibility.
advice.roslin: More surface area catching fire than civilians. That's a fleet-first trade.

title: Anyone Could Be a Cylon
joke: Gaeta reports two transponders. One pilot. He's chosen not to ask.
plain: Once per cycle per stack, a lethal hit downloads you into a fresh Viper with 1.5 s cover.

advice.baltar: Die once, come back once. I'd call that a fair trade, wouldn't you?
advice.roslin: A lethal hit becomes a fresh start, once a cycle. Don't waste the reprieve.

title: Bootleg Hooch (Unlabeled)
joke: Tyrol's private stash. The gun found a rhythm; your legs did not.

advice.baltar: Faster trigger, slower feet. I've made worse trades for less alcohol.
advice.roslin: Firepower up, mobility down. Pick your moments, not your enemies.

title: Continuity of Government
joke: PLACEHOLDER: Roslin's favorite. The quota is the quota.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Less damage in one 33. I can live with a quota.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: The civilians cannot take a worse 33 than this. Hold that line.

title: Flak Enthusiast
joke: PLACEHOLDER: Galactica has opinions about incoming mail.
plain: Galactica intercepts 40% of strays, plus 15% per extra stack. Strafes still land.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Fewer holes in the civilians. I can live with a loud sky.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: Let the guns work. You cover what they miss.

title: Hangar Door Slam
joke: PLACEHOLDER: Kick them while the doors are open.
plain: +30% damage to the resurrection ship while its bays are open, per stack.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Wait for the gap. Then be unkind.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: The factory is busiest when it is receiving. That is when you hit it.

title: Imaginary Six
joke: PLACEHOLDER: An ally only you can see.
plain: A wingman only you can see. She cuts down strafes and stray rounds in range. Others will ask who you are talking to.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: I am not seeing anyone. That is probably fine.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: If she is watching the civilians, I will not ask twice.

title: Raptor Escort
joke: PLACEHOLDER: They volunteered. Do not make it a habit.
plain: A Raptor patrols the fleet line and soaks strays. After 3 hits it hangars until the next cycle.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Someone else catching the mail. I like this person.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: They will not stay up forever. Cover them when they peel off.

title: Overcompensating Cannon
joke: PLACEHOLDER: The round is late. The round is huge.
plain: Slower, bigger shots that pierce two extra Raiders per stack.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: One shot, several problems. I love efficiency.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: Lead the shot. It will not hurry for you.

title: Personal Vendetta
joke: PLACEHOLDER: The missile has opinions about the factory.
plain: Missiles lock the resurrection ship whenever it is on screen. -20% missile speed. Escorts still intercept.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Ignore the small ones. The factory is the point. Mostly.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: Escorts will still eat the round. Position anyway.

title: Your Call Is Important to Us
joke: PLACEHOLDER: Please continue to hold. Your resurrection is very important to us.

advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: A slower queue is a quieter sky. Take it.

title: Spoilers
joke: PLACEHOLDER: You already know how this download ends.
plain: Ghost blips sit on the return column. Shooting one delays that download 3 seconds per stack.

advice.baltar: PLACEHOLDER: Shoot the future. I love a spoiler.
advice.roslin: PLACEHOLDER: Every second they wait is a second the fleet does not.
